our_interpretation: The plain reading is an architectural necessity claim: a world model needs accessible, structured knowledge of the listed kinds to perform formal reasoning about the world.
Formal reasoning means deriving conclusions through specified inference rules. Physical prediction or successful robot control alone does not establish that capability.
The parenthetical qualifies his confidence in the thesis. It is not an independently observable forecast condition, and the correctness of his entire 2020 article is not assumed.
A narrow mathematical theorem prover would not by itself settle what a general world model requires.
criteria.support_condition: A demonstrated necessity result, with assumptions matching the claimed world-model capability, establishes that the specified knowledge and representation are required. Successful examples using that representation alone are insufficient.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A documented world model performs valid formal reasoning about the world while demonstrably lacking the stipulated explicit, structured, directly retrievable knowledge.
